Bloomberg Daybreak Europe is your essential morning viewing to stay ahead. 

On today's show, Iran wants to bar US and Israeli ships from crossing the Strait of Hormuz, according to Iranian media reports on a proposed deal being discussed by Iran and Oman. title_cn: 负担能力是中期选举的首要问题：众议员克拉克
summary: House Minority Whip Katherine Clark (D-MA) says progressive Abdul Ed-Sayed's win in Michigan is a signal that voters are looking for "fighters" who will stand up for them in Congress. She says she believes Democrats will have the majority in the House come November, while signaling openness to a stopgap bill to avert a shutdown, noting that the Senate's proposal is a "big improvement." She speaks with Kailey Leinz and Joe Mathieu on the late edition of Bloomberg’s "Balance of Power." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Sen. Cramer: Funding Vote Is Senate’s Top Priority
title_cn: 克莱默参议员：资助投票是参议院的首要任务
summary: With just one day left in the Senate’s session before a scheduled August recess, Republican Senator Kevin Cramer of North Dakota says lawmakers’ first priority is passing a continuing resolution to fund the government through December 11. On Republican holdouts over Todd Blanche’s nomination for attorney general, Cramer says he is hopeful President Donald Trump could weigh in and persuade them to support his nominee. He also says regular conversations between Trump and Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh are appropriate, noting it would be “strange” if they weren’t speaking somewhat regularly, as long as the central bank remains independent. He speaks with Kailey Leinz and Joe Mathieu on the late edition of Bloomberg’s "Balance of Power." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Trump Order Sets 15% Tariff, Price Floors on Polysilicon Imports
title_cn: 特朗普命令对多晶硅进口设定 15% 的关税和价格下限
summary: President Donald Trump ordered new tariffs as well as price floors on imported polysilicon used in semiconductors and solar panels, warning that US reliance on foreign supplies threatens national security.

title: Trump Administration Considers Order on Autism and Vaccines
title_cn: 特朗普政府考虑对自闭症和疫苗颁布命令
summary: The Trump administration is actively considering issuing an executive order on vaccines and autism as soon as next week, according to people familiar with the matter.
